features.message: You can now select your preferred speed units: km/h, kt or m/s.
Now the Flyable Windows chart displays the best spots for the selected day by default. A day-to-day comparison is still available by switching the mode to Date mode.
The map has been tweaked for better clickability. Now selecting a point on the map will make it so that location is selected everywhere else.
Sunny Mode and Large Font are now available in the Settings, to make it easier to see the app for different people in different conditions.
